record.title: Elevated Errors Ingesting Metrics in AWS US East (OH) - prod-us-east-0

updates.body: Between 14:40 and 15:00 UTC on 2026-10-12 (approximately 20 minutes), customers in AWS US East (OH) - prod-us-east-0, may have experienced failed metric writes to Grafana Cloud Metrics. This has been fully resolved and all services are operating normally.
